entries.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: wide pixel-art game environment key art. Create an exquisite isometric ancient Chinese imperial palace courtyard at dusk for a Three Kingdoms strategy card game. Genuine crisp hand-crafted 16-bit pixel art: stepped discrete pixels, limited ink-blue, jade-green, warm gold and terracotta palette. Timber pavilion with curved tiled roofs, lanterns casting amber light, chunky cubic trees, stone courtyard, a jade tactical tabletop in the center. Cinematic but clearly pixel art, atmospheric depth, no smooth photorealism. Wide landscape composition, restful darker space toward the left for HTML title; most pavilion detail on right. No people, no typography, no letters, no watermark. This is artwork, not a UI screenshot.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: single portrait card back texture for a Three Kingdoms pixel-art game. Front-facing perfectly rectangular ornate card back, full image filled by the card surface, no perspective and no surrounding table. Genuine crisp 16-bit pixel art with discrete square pixels. Ink-navy field, jade lattice corners, elegant gold imperial dragon seal centered, symmetrical gold border, warm parchment edge, subtle pixel texture. Precious restrained palace aesthetic, legible strong silhouette. No text, no numbers, no watermark, no gradient smoothing.

entries.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a production sprite atlas for pixel-art Three Kingdoms card illustrations. ONE single sprite-sheet asset. EXACTLY 7 equal columns by 6 equal rows, all cells same dimensions, straight aligned boundaries, no gutters, each cell filled edge-to-edge with its own illustration. Front-facing rectangular sheet, no perspective. Crisp authentic 16-bit pixel art, ink-blue/jade/gold/terracotta palette, no text or numbers anywhere, no UI frames, no labels, no watermark. Each illustration has centered clearly recognizable subject and simple dark backdrop. Subjects row-major order MUST be: row1: sword slash; dodge nimble warrior silhouette; peach fruit; ceramic wine flask; crackling thunder sword; thief hand taking pouch; shattered scroll. row2: treasure chest coins; two crossed duel swords; barbarian horned army; shower of arrows; blossoming peach garden; iron chain links; burning fire orb. row3: protective magic talisman; golden wheat harvest; two warriors borrowing a sword; lightning bolt storm; idle court noble resting; empty grain sacks; repeating crossbow. row4: blue steel straight sword; six swords fan formation; ornate kirin bow; white feather fan; serpent headed spear; icy sword; two bladed trident. row5: heavy rock axe; green dragon guandao; sky piercing halberd; black-white twin swords; tiger shield; eight trigrams shield; silver lion helmet; woven rattan armor. row6: gray lightning hoof horse; red hare horse; white Fergana horse; black shadow runner horse; wooden transport cart; empty dark jade ornamental square; empty dark jade ornamental square. Flat exact 7x6 tile layout; all 42 tile positions present. Each tile is separate contained art with nothing crossing boundaries.
